items.t: Plastic cooling system parts crack, leak or break
items.job: Replace water pump, thermostat, radiator, tank and hoses
items.note: Parts are FCP Euro E46 cooling overhaul kits ($300–$705). YourMechanic lists about $294 labor for the water pump alone on a 325i; a full overhaul with radiator and hoses takes longer. One part alone costs less. Overheat damage adds a lot.

items.t: Power window regulator failure
items.note: Price is per door. YourMechanic: about $188 average for a 325i regulator ($93 parts, $95 labor); some door/year combos run higher. A new motor, if needed, adds to the cost.

items.t: Oil filter housing and valve cover gasket leaks
items.note: Based on YourMechanic: about $305 average for a 328i oil filter housing gasket ($58 parts, $247 labor). A leaking valve cover gasket is a separate job and adds to the cost.

items.t: Electric water pump and thermostat failure
items.job: Replace electric water pump and thermostat
items.note: RepairPal: $940–$1,111 total for a 2007–2010 335i and $1,186–$1,700 for 2011–2015. YourMechanic: about $1,080 average ($688 parts, $392 labor). Used as the basis.

items.t: Crankcase vent valve heater can short and start a fire
items.note: Free under recall 17V-683 (19V-273 for 2006). Check the VIN first.

items.t: Blower motor wiring can overheat
items.note: Free under recall 17V-676. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Battery cable connector can lose power
items.note: Free under recall 13V-044. Check the VIN first.

items.t: High-pressure fuel pump failure on the 335i
items.note: BMW once extended coverage on this pump. It has likely ended, but ask a dealer with your VIN.

items.t: Turbo wastegate rattle on the 335i
items.note: Based on RepairPal: $4,295–$7,794 total for a 2009 335i turbo replacement. Aftermarket or rebuilt turbos cost less than new BMW units.

items.t: Leaking or misfiring fuel injectors on the 335i
items.note: Based on YourMechanic: about $1,325 average for a 335i ($863 parts, $462 labor). Replacing only the failed injector costs less, but many shops do all six.

items.t: VANOS housing bolts can loosen or break
items.note: Free under recalls 14V-176 and 23V-707. Check the VIN. Cost rises if loose bolts damaged the engine.

items.t: Timing chain guide failure on the 2.0L turbo
items.job: Replace timing chain, guides and tensioner
items.note: FCP Euro install guide: parts and tools near $1,200 DIY, 10–15 hours of shop labor, and dealer bills upward of $5,000. BMW extended chain coverage to 7 years/70,000 miles on many cars (SIB 11 03 17); ask a dealer with your VIN. If the chain breaks, the engine may need replacing.

items.t: Brake vacuum pump can fail
items.note: Free under recalls 13V-454 and 14V-627. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Electric coolant pump connector can short
items.note: Free under recall 24V-608. Check the VIN first. Replacing the whole pump costs more.

items.t: Balance shaft bearings may be installed incorrectly
items.note: Recall 19V-732 replaces affected engines for free. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Outer tie rod may break
items.note: Free under recall 20V-355. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Starter or starter relay may overheat
items.note: Free under recalls 25V-636, 24V-576 and 26V-056. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Rearview camera image may be blocked or blank
items.note: Free under recall 21V-096. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Headlight control units may fail
items.note: Free under recall 19V-850. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Starter-generator battery connection may loosen
items.note: Free under recall 25V-202. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Brake assist may be lost after engine start
items.note: Free under recall 21V-598. Check the VIN first.

items.t: High-voltage battery cells may short
items.job: Inspect and replace battery modules if needed (recall)
items.note: Free under recall 20V-601 (also see 20V-490). Check the VIN first, and follow BMW charging instructions until it is fixed.

items.t: 48-volt battery connection may overheat
items.job: Inspect 48-volt cable nuts and replace if loose (recall)
items.note: Free under recall 20V-761. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Transmission control unit may leak internally
items.note: Covered by recalls 22V-070 and 23V-821. Check the VIN first.
